title: Line item detail
description: A custom line item or note under a document line.

invoice_item_id.description: The line's ID, on invoice lines

order_item_id.description: The line's ID, on order lines

quote_item_id.description: The line's ID, on quote lines

credit_item_id.description: The line's ID, on credit lines

purchase_item_id.description: The line's ID, on purchase lines

kind.description: `custom_line_item` and `note` details can be sent. `tax` details are reserved for sales tax and don't include a rate or amount yet.

position.description: The detail's order under its line, starting at 0.

internal_note.description: True for a note meant for your team only. Internal notes aren't shown to customers.

custom_line_item.description: The custom line item, for `custom_line_item` details. Wherefour works out its price from the custom line definition and the line.

count.description: A decimal, sent as a string

unit_price.description: A decimal, sent as a string

force_subtotal.description: A decimal, sent as a string; set when the subtotal was entered by hand

subtotal.description: A decimal, sent as a string

qualified.description: Whether the custom line item currently qualifies and counts toward the document's subtotal.
